$comment: eAgent orchestration (#EXP-1508): the thresholds, copy and fixture defaults every other fixture here replays against. Derived from Exponential's server (apps/web/src/lib/sessions, lib/agents/triggers.ts) on 2026-10-31; apps/web/src/lib/sessions/eagent-spec.test.ts fails when the server drifts from them (contract.json sessionsSend/sessionWatchdog/device/agentTrigger, SESSION_TREE_MAX_*, BUS_COPY, askText, TRIGGER_COPY). Times are unix ms (eCore), ids follow eCore's id rule, refusals are eCore Failures. Copy placeholders are `{name}`; the composite pieces are spelled out next to each template.

caps.$comment: A child sits at most treeMaxDepth below its root (root = depth 0). A tree holds at most treeMaxSessions LIVE sessions (status != ended, the root included): an ended branch frees its slot. Depth refuses with eCore `invalid`, the live cap with `limit`.

reuse.$comment: S-3: an AGENT's message (the caller's tree has an acting agent: its root's agentId, else startedByAgentId) to another tree's ROOT thread reuses it only while: the thread waits on an answer (needsInput) or on the caller (#FEED-172, `awaitsCaller`), else it ended < maxEndedHours ago (or is live), its last turn (else activity, else its last write) is < maxIdleHours old and it has < maxChildren sub-sessions (every child row ever, ended ones too). A refused reuse never fails: a fresh root starts on the same device with the same message, watched by the caller, and the result carries `warning`.

watchdog.$comment: The server watchdog (every minute). backgroundStuckMinutes: a run busy only with background tasks is alive that long without a sign of life, then measured like any busy one. onlineWindowSeconds: a device not seen this long is offline.

trigger.$comment: A schedule firing more than caughtUpAfterMinutes after its due minute says it was caught up. catchUpHours bounds the window the host scheduler searches (cron matching is the host's, never the core's).

copy.blocked: Hit a usage limit{detail}. It stays blocked until its login rotates or the limit resets; nothing to do unless it should move or end.

blockedDetail.$comment: {detail}: window + resetsAt = ` ({window} window, resets {resetsAt})`, window only = ` ({window} window)`, resetsAt only = ` (resets {resetsAt})`, neither = ``.

copy.unclaimed: Not picked up by its device for {minutes} minutes (still queued). The device may be offline; a person sees it under Needs you.
copy.stuck: No sign of life for {minutes} minutes while busy (no message, tool call, push or background task). Check whether it is still needed.
copy.unresumed: Interrupted {minutes}+ minutes ago and not continued by its device. A person sees it under Needs you; a message continues it.
copy.private:
{lead}
Read it with exponential_sessions({op: "get", id: "{id}"}) if your account may see it.
copy.privatePrLead: A private chat opened a pull request.
copy.askPrivateQuestionLead: Asks a question in a private chat.
copy.askPrivatePlanLead: Proposes a plan in a private chat.

askQuestion.$comment:
Lines joined by 
, the options line only with options: `{askQuestionLead}{question}`, `Options: {a | b}{flags}` (flags = ` (several allowed, free text allowed)` from multi and custom != false, each only when set, nothing when neither), then `answer`. The plan joins its blocks by 

: askPlanLead, the plan clipped to ask.planMax (longer = the first planMax-1 characters, end-trimmed, plus `…`), `Questions:` + one `- {id}: {prompt} ({label | label})` line each (only with questions), then `decide`.
askQuestion.answer: Answer with exponential_sessions_send({sessionId: "{id}", answer: {…}}) where answer = {answers: ["<option>"]} or {answer: "<text>"} if you know it; otherwise end your turn, a person answers in the card.
askQuestion.decide: Decide with exponential_sessions_send({sessionId: "{id}", answer: {…}}) where answer = {decision: "approved" | "rejected", answers: {"<question id>": ["<option>"]}, feedback: "<text>"} if it is yours to decide; otherwise end your turn, a person decides in the card.

copy.askHidden:
{lead}
Read it with exponential_sessions({op: "get", id: "{id}"}) and answer with exponential_sessions_send({sessionId: "{id}", answer: {…}}) if you may see it; otherwise end your turn, a person answers in the card.
copy.scheduleCaughtUp: (caught up: this tick was missed earlier)
copy.reuseEnded: it ended more than {hours} h ago
copy.reuseIdle: its last turn is more than {hours} h old
copy.freshThread: Started a fresh thread instead of reusing {id}: {reason}. You watch the new one.
copy.tooMany: A chat runs at most {max} sessions at once
copy.endedNeedsMessage: This session has ended: send a message to continue it
copy.endedNothingToAnswer: This session has ended: nothing to answer
copy.otherDevice: This session runs on another device
copy.replyEmpty: A reply needs a body or a card

defaults.$comment: What a fixture's `given` omits. rootId/depth follow parentId (a root is its own root at depth 0) and a child shares its root's `shared` unless it names its own. A device omitted from `given` is offline; a session's host is the device its deviceId names. A given session is claimed (startedAt 0) unless it says `startedAt: null`.
